Do you carry trays full of wine more balanced than a gymnastic on the balance beam? We're on the lookout for hospitable servers for our in-house restaurant The Lobby. Apply now!

As a Food & Beverage Service Employee, you are at the very heart of our restaurant. You work across breakfast, lunch, and dinner service, serving dishes, creating a warm atmosphere, and ensuring guests have an unforgettable experience — often before they even ask. No two days are the same, as you effortlessly switch between different moments of the day in a dynamic and lively environment.

You're an all-rounder: you take reservations, welcome and seat guests, take orders, serve dishes, and handle payments smoothly. You work according to established procedures, while keeping your approach personal and genuinely hospitable. At the same time, you make sure every table experience is spot on — from start to finish. You introduce guests to high-quality products and fine wines, and have a natural feel for what each guest needs. That's what makes the difference between simply dining out and an experience to remember.

Our menu continuously surprises with seasonal, honest dishes — from generous pancakes to refined eggs Benedict and classic salads. You present and serve these dishes in a warm and professional way, ensuring every guest enjoys a complete experience.

Our restaurant on Fizeaustraat is located in a vibrant neighborhood in Amsterdam East, where both locals and tourists love to come together. Away from the hustle and bustle, yet still easily accessible. Whether guests stop by for breakfast, drinks, or a relaxing moment by the fireplace, you make sure they feel welcome and at home right away.

jobs.occupation: Sparagus - Principal Architect — OS & System Performance
jobs.description:
The R&D Center of a global leading ICT company, based in Amsterdam.

We are looking for a senior architect to drive the design and development of advanced OS-level system performance technologies and Hardware-software-chip co-optimization for next-generation computing devices.

The role focuses on system scheduling and performance optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, operating system, and chipset layers, balancing performance, power consumption, and thermal constraints. You will work across operating system, Hardware, chipset, runtime, and application layers, driving technologies from architecture and research through implementation and deployment on end devices.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop Hardware-software-chip co-optimization and integrated system scheduling technologies, including CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling, priority management, task grouping, core selection, frequency scaling, resource allocation, and performance/power/thermal-aware scheduling.

• Research and optimize application performance at the OS level, improving application interaction, responsiveness, animation smoothness, and overall system performance.

• Design and optimize high-performance core system modules and resolve critical system performance bottlenecks.

• Research and develop high-performance APIs, runtimes, application frameworks, and performance-oriented system technologies.

• Track advanced industry technologies and academic research and contribute to future technical roadmaps for system performance, scheduling, and Hardware-software co-optimization.

• Drive technical solutions from architecture and research through implementation, validation, and deployment on end devices.

Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:

• OS or kernel performance optimization

• CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling and system resource management

• Hardware-software or chipset-level co-optimization

• Power- and thermal-aware scheduling and optimization

• Application or runtime performance optimization

• High-performance system, runtime, or framework design

In addition:

• Strong understanding of operating system architecture and system performance fundamentals.

• Hands-on experience identifying and resolving complex system performance bottlenecks.

• Proven ability to deliver measurable performance improvements in real-world systems or products.

• Strong problem-solving and engineering execution capabilities, with the ability to drive solutions from architecture and design through implementation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across international research and engineering teams.

Preferred skills:

• Experience with Linux, Android, or other modern operating-system platforms.

• Experience with kernel scheduling, Dvfs/frequency scaling, heterogeneous computing, graphics/GPU systems, memory systems, or chipset-level optimization.

• Experience working across Hardware and software boundaries on complex computing platforms.

• Experience translating research or advanced technical concepts into production-level system technologies.

jobs.occupation: Sparagus - Senior Engineer - AI - Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.

You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.
What you'll do

• Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.

• Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.

• Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.

• Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.

• Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.

• Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.

• Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What we're looking for

• Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.

• Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, Lsp, or similar architectures.

• Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.

• Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.

• Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

• Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.

• Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to have:

• Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.

• Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.

• Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.

• Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.

• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.

Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.

The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment.
